# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

This c3pm manages packages for the C3 programming language and c3c compiler. It is separate from the older C++ project with the same name.

The current documented release is {{ site.c3pm_version }}. The supported platform is Linux x86_64. c3pm manages C3 source dependencies, native libraries, project toolchains, and portable application bundles through Nix.

The links below lead to the official documentation. Package names in a registry use `namespace/name`; a C3 library's manifest `provides` name can differ from its registry package name.

{% endfor %}{% endfor %}
